title: Inventory repository and verify report
instruction: Read files/history/scripts; note actual implemented routes and git state
acceptance: Route and feature inventory with code links; no modifications made

title: Match final lecturer requirements
instruction: Collect current brief and map each rubric criterion
acceptance: Written scoped must-have checklist; unknown items explicitly flagged

title: Record architecture decision
instruction: Choose Firebase reuse vs mandatory migration; document history
acceptance: Decision approved and final diagram matches plan

title: Choose safe demo environment and provision roles
instruction: Inspect seed script/project ID/role policy
acceptance: Dedicated Student and Organizer valid roles; no secret leak

title: Record baseline tests and lint/build
instruction: Run existing npm tests and syntax checks
acceptance: Commands/results saved; failures tracked

title: Inventory and publish authoritative API contract
instruction: Inspect each endpoint/request/response/code/status
acceptance: Contract suitable for typed frontend; no guessed fields

title: Resolve CLOSED lifecycle mismatch
instruction: Decide approved rule and update API/tests/docs
acceptance: Visible/status transitions match decision and tests

title: Resolve cancellation route mismatch
instruction: Align client/server/docs and keep compatibility if needed
acceptance: Real cancellation works with documented method/body

title: Add cross-origin browser CORS
instruction: Explicit origin allowlist and preflight
acceptance: Deployed/local browser frontend can call API and auth still enforced

title: Audit auth ownership/privacy
instruction: Roles from server; own events/registrations; restrict logs
acceptance: 403/401 privacy tests pass and logs redacted

title: Expand emulator backend tests
instruction: Auth, transaction duplicate, cancel, invalid, lifecycle
acceptance: Automated integration suite with honest output

title: Audit Team 10 retry worker behavior
instruction: Preserve integration; inspect backoff/recovery/logging
acceptance: Documented safe worker behavior and test plan

title: Scaffold frontend and shared design system
instruction: React Vite routing, shell, tokens, reusable components
acceptance: Local app builds and responsive structure exists

title: Integrate real Firebase client login
instruction: Token/session, role routing, protected route UX
acceptance: Both accounts sign in and protected API is called

title: Events browse/details from API
instruction: Real list and detail, all async states
acceptance: Events shown match Firestore via API, refresh works

title: Student register real event
instruction: Register, conflict handling, pending state
acceptance: One persisted active registration, no duplicate

title: My Registrations and cancel
instruction: Own list, cancellation confirmation, refetch
acceptance: Cancellation persists and unauthorized own-only tested

title: Organizer event list and role gate
instruction: Real own events, permission check
acceptance: Student denied; Organizer sees only own records

title: Organizer create/edit/publish event
instruction: API-backed form and lifecycle states
acceptance: New event persists and appears for Student

title: Organizer registration roster
instruction: Real registrations for owned event
acceptance: Student registration appears; cross-owner denial

title: Cross-role end-to-end journey
instruction: Two profiles, create→publish→register→roster→cancel
acceptance: Whole real flow passes after reload

title: Responsive/accessibility/error QA
instruction: 360/768/1440, keyboard, offline/403/empty
acceptance: No blocked interactions; screenshots and issues logged

title: Controlled demo accounts and seed events
instruction: Idempotent safe seed; no false real-world claims
acceptance: 4–6 sample events, roles valid, seeded labels shown

title: Deploy frontend/API safely
instruction: Environment secrets, SPA deep-link rewrite, CORS
acceptance: Live HTTPS UI connects to persistent backend

title: Run deployed authenticated smoke suite
instruction: Test real Firestore read/write and auth privacy
acceptance: Live P0 checks pass with timestamp and evidence

title: Verify partner integration honestly
instruction: Recheck if partner accessible; historical fallback labeled
acceptance: Integration evidence/limitations accurate

title: Prepare final demo/docs/submission
instruction: Demo walkthrough, README, credits, rubric mapping
acceptance: Rehearsed live demo and genuine evidence pack

title: Paginate large lists when needed
instruction: Avoid silent 50-record truncation
acceptance: UI/API show correct paging with tests

title: Automate UI E2E tests
instruction: Auth and role journeys with test environment
acceptance: Repeatable browser tests with documented fixture isolation

title: Capture automatic consumer recovery evidence
instruction: If required, demonstrate genuinely without manual trigger
acceptance: Redacted verified recovery trace; or honest gap

title: Add lightweight search/filter if required
instruction: Only on verified data, no fake counts
acceptance: Correct search/filter with empty states
